capabilities.agent-factory: Generated agent package validation and runtime skill contracts.
capabilities.architecture-verification: Go dependency-boundary checkers for product layers.
capabilities.cli-e2e: Isolated end-to-end dogfooding of the public CLI.
capabilities.delivery: GitHub delivery metadata and Issue/Project projection.
capabilities.installation: Bootstrap, release installers and source installation.
capabilities.maintainer-acceptance: S7/S9 acceptance tooling and historical acceptance Evidence companions.

capabilities.repository-validation: Aggregate repository and harness checks, including automation governance.

entries.purpose: Required product checks on every pull request and main push: Go tests, vet/build, repository checks, dogfood smoke test, Windows installer/bootstrap contracts, and the release-contract job.
entries.trigger: pull_request, push to main, and workflow_dispatch (dispatched by release-pr-checks.sh for the Release PR branch)
entries.inputs: GitHub event; repository checkout; go.mod Go version; matrix linux/macos/windows plus release-contract job
entries.outputs: Required check contexts verify (linux|macos|windows) and release-contract; step failures fail the run
entries.network_effects: GitHub Actions checkout and setup-go; Go module download
entries.authority: contents: read token only; no secrets, no publication path

entries.purpose: Validate PR title and Related-Issues/Completes-Issues metadata, refuse GitHub closing links, and accept only the bot-authored Release PR head on dispatch.
entries.trigger: pull_request opened/edited/reopened/synchronize; workflow_dispatch for the Release PR branch
entries.inputs: PR title/body via env vars, base-revision checkout, dispatch branch/sha/actor
entries.outputs: delivery-metadata check pass/fail; step summary; failure on invalid metadata or closing links
entries.network_effects: GitHub API via gh/GraphQL (read-only: pulls, closingIssuesReferences)
entries.authority: permissions contents: read, pull-requests: read; no secrets; validator script taken from base/default branch

entries.purpose: Project merged deliveries onto Issues (and the delivery Project when enabled) after each push to main.
entries.trigger: push to main
entries.inputs: push event after-SHA; .github/delivery-project.json projection flag; secret AXIOM_DELIVERY_PROJECT_TOKEN in the sync-project job
entries.outputs: Issue comments, Project Status/Target Release updates, premature-closure reopen; step summary
entries.network_effects: GitHub API writes via gh (Issue comments, Issue reopen; Project v2 GraphQL when projection enabled)
entries.authority: permissions contents: read, issues: write, pull-requests: read; sync-project job uses environment delivery and the Project token secret

entries.purpose: Validate the landing page in site/ and publish it to GitHub Pages after validation on main.
entries.trigger: push to main, pull_request, or workflow_dispatch; pushes and PRs filtered to site/, docs/assets/, validate-landing-page.sh and this workflow
entries.inputs: site/ tree; docs/assets; GitHub event
entries.outputs: Validation result; Pages artifact and deployment on main (not on pull requests)
entries.local_effects: runner workspace only (artifact tar in RUNNER_TEMP)
entries.network_effects: GitHub Actions checkout/configure-pages/upload-artifact/deploy-pages; Pages deployment
entries.authority: contents: read; deploy job adds pages: write and id-token: write in environment github-pages; actions pinned to SHAs

entries.purpose: PUBLISH phase: re-verifies the prepared artifact at the revision, matches the authorized envelope digest and creates the tag and GitHub Release; the only workflow that does.
entries.trigger: workflow_dispatch from main, dispatched by release.sh publish with tag, revision, prepared run and authorized preview_digest
entries.inputs: workflow_dispatch inputs tag, revision, prepared_run, preview_digest, optional corrections_revision, corrections_digest, repair_revision; downloads artifact axiom-release-<tag>
entries.outputs: GitHub Release with tag, draft/assets/publication effects, Issue and Release PR effects; publication envelope in the step summary
entries.local_effects: none on the runner beyond checkouts and temporary files
entries.network_effects: GitHub API writes via publish-release.sh: tag, Release, assets, Release PR label, delivery Issue/Project effects; reads check runs and artifacts
entries.authority: publish job waits for the protected release environment; secrets AXIOM_RELEASE_PUBLISH_TOKEN and optional AXIOM_DELIVERY_PROJECT_TOKEN; GITHUB_TOKEN limited to contents/actions/checks read, issues and pull-requests write
entries.evidence: Consumes prepared artifact axiom-release-<tag> of the prepared run; writes publication.txt to the step summary

entries.purpose: PREPARE phase: builds, verifies and renders notes for the complete artifact set from one preflighted revision and retains it as the workflow artifact axiom-release-<tag>.
entries.trigger: workflow_dispatch from main, dispatched by release.sh prepare with tag and revision (optional pinned correction inputs)
entries.inputs: workflow_dispatch inputs tag, revision, optional corrections_revision, corrections_digest; checks out source (and control) revisions
entries.outputs: Uploaded artifact axiom-release-<tag> (archives, SHA256SUMS, preflight.txt, release-evidence.txt, release-notes.md, prepare-metadata.txt, optional release-recovery.txt), 30-day retention
entries.local_effects: none on the runner beyond checkouts and temporary files
entries.network_effects: GitHub API read-only (Issue titles, artifact upload); Go module download and verification
entries.authority: GITHUB_TOKEN read-only (contents: read, issues: read); never creates tags or Releases
entries.evidence: Produces the prepared release artifact consumed by release.sh and publish-release.yml

entries.purpose: Command-driven Release PR: re-runs the release plan on the planned main SHA, runs Release Please without creating Releases and dispatches required checks on the Release PR.
entries.trigger: workflow_dispatch from main, dispatched by release.sh start with planned_version and the validated main SHA
entries.inputs: workflow_dispatch inputs planned_version, main; release-please-config.json, .release-please-manifest.json
entries.outputs: Created or updated Release PR (CHANGELOG.md and manifest); plan Evidence in the step summary; dispatched ci.yml and delivery-metadata.yml runs
entries.local_effects: none on the runner beyond checkouts and temporary files
entries.network_effects: GitHub API writes via Release Please (Release PR branch, PR, labels) and gh workflow run; no tags or Releases (skip-github-release)
entries.authority: dispatch from main with planned main SHA; GITHUB_TOKEN with contents, pull-requests, issues and actions write

entries.outputs: Phase result line on stdout and exit 0; --plan prints the envelope digest as JSON; failures on stderr; Evidence directory with manifest.json and artifacts/.

entries.network_effects: none by itself; reviewed steps may declare external effects recorded in the ledger
entries.authority: human-authorized envelope SHA-256 (--approved-envelope-sha256) and approved parameters per phase; none for --plan
entries.evidence: manifest.json and retained step output under the --evidence-dir, bound to the envelope digest.

entries.outputs: Evidence directory with envelope.json, manifest.json and acceptance.md; errors via argparse/stderr; non-zero exit on failure.

entries.evidence: envelope.json, manifest.json and acceptance.md under the --evidence-dir; consumes the reviewed candidate descriptor.

entries.purpose: Builds the four supported cross-platform release archives, per-bundle manifests and SHA256SUMS from the clean checked-out source revision.
entries.trigger: Every release preparation run (release-artifacts.yml, via release.sh prepare); also archive and installer tests
entries.inputs: --version X.Y.Z[-pre] (required), --output ABS_DIR (required, empty or new), --development (allows dirty source); reads git HEAD and status, LICENSE, scripts/install-release.{sh,ps1}, internal/codexruntime/skills
entries.outputs: stdout release_build_success: <output>; stderr release_build_error and exit 1 on invalid input; writes four axiom-<version>-<platform>-<arch>.tar.gz archives and SHA256SUMS under --output
entries.local_effects: Creates and writes the --output directory (must be empty); temporary work directory removed on exit
entries.network_effects: none by the script itself (go build may use the module cache or proxy)
entries.authority: none; local build only, release builds refuse a dirty source unless --development
entries.evidence: Produces the archive set and SHA256SUMS later verified by verify-release-artifacts.sh and retained as the prepared release artifact

entries.purpose: Shared AST engine that parses one product layer's sources and rejects non-allowlisted imports and symbols, test-only imports in production files, test I/O helpers and compiler directives under that layer's independent policy profile: domain (internal/project) or application (internal/projectapp).
entries.trigger: Manual run (go run ./scripts/check-architecture.go domain|application from the repository root) whenever domain or application code or its tests change; built by its fixture tests.
entries.inputs: One profile argument (domain or application); reads internal/project/*.go or internal/projectapp/*.go relative to the current directory.
entries.outputs: 'PASS: <n> <domain|application> source/test files...' on stdout and exit 0; 'FAIL: <reason>' on stderr and exit 1; missing, unknown or extra arguments print usage on stderr and exit 2 (go run reports 'exit status 2' and exits 1).
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: none; read-only local checks

entries.purpose: Validate that every governed automation surface is registered in scripts/automation-registry.json and that entries satisfy the repository automation policy schema.
entries.trigger: Every repository validation via validate-repository.sh (CI repository checks on linux and macos, maintainer validation before a change is complete).
entries.inputs: Optional ROOT directory (default .); reads scripts/automation-registry.json and the git listing of tracked and untracked non-ignored files.
entries.outputs: PASS line on stdout; one FAIL line per violation on stderr; exit 0 when valid, 1 on violations, 2 on usage error.
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: none; read-only local checks; never executes registered automation or evaluates registry values

entries.purpose: Closed check that CLAUDE.md is exactly '@AGENTS.md', that no other Claude artifact exists and, with --skill-adapters, that .claude/skills holds only relative symlinks to canonical .agents/skills.
entries.trigger: Every repository validation and every generated-package validation (via validate-repository.sh and validate-agent-package.sh) and the maintainer-agent structural evaluation.
entries.inputs: Optional --skill-adapters flag and target directory (default .); reads CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/ and .agents/skills.
entries.outputs: Exit 0 silently on success; 'FAIL: <reason>' on stderr and exit 1.
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: none; read-only local checks

entries.purpose: Reject forbidden sensitive file paths and high-confidence secret patterns (private keys, GitHub tokens, AWS access keys) in the worktree, the staged index or a plain directory.
entries.trigger: Every repository validation (validate-repository.sh), every generated-package validation (validate-agent-package.sh) and pre-commit use via --staged.
entries.inputs: Optional --staged or --directory flag and a target directory (default .); reads git index or files under the target.
entries.outputs: 'PASS: sensitive-file checks passed (<mode>)' on stdout and exit 0; ERROR lines then 'FAIL: ...' on stderr and exit 1.
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: none; read-only local checks

entries.purpose: GitHub delivery projection of Issue metadata: read-only state/preflight/verify/titles/release-pr-head plus release and sync modes that comment, close/reopen Issues and set Project fields.
entries.trigger: every push to main (delivery-sync.yml sync), every Release PR dispatch (delivery-metadata.yml), and stable release publication/verification/notes
entries.inputs: mode state|preflight|release|verify|titles|release-pr-head|sync; --repo/--tag/--revision/--expect/--from/--to/--branch/--sha/--actor; .github/delivery-project.json; env GH_TOKEN, AXIOM_DELIVERY_PROJECT_TOKEN, optional AXIOM_RELEASE_CORRECTIONS_*
entries.outputs: effect= lines and delivery state to stdout; delivery_github_error to stderr and exit 1 on failure; tokens never printed
entries.network_effects: GitHub REST/GraphQL via gh: reads Issues, comments, PRs, releases; writes Issue comments (POST), Issue close/reopen (PATCH), Project v2 fields (separate token)
entries.authority: caller gh credentials with issues: write for comments and closure; AXIOM_DELIVERY_PROJECT_TOKEN only when delivery-project.json projection is enabled; read-only modes need read access

entries.purpose: Parse Related-Issues/Completes-Issues metadata, check PRs, list per-commit delivery lines and resolve the Issue set of a stable release from Git history.
entries.trigger: every PR metadata check, merge-time sync, release planning, and stable release resolution
entries.inputs: mode parse|check-pr|commits|release; --file/--body/--title/--from/--to/--tag/--revision; local Git history; .github/delivery-corrections.txt at the resolved revision
entries.outputs: metadata=/related=/completes= lines or one line per commit to stdout; delivery_metadata_error to stderr and exit 1
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: none; local read-only Git inspection

entries.purpose: Isolated end-to-end lifecycle of the source-installed public CLI against fake gh and temporary roots, emitting an axiom_e2e_dogfood pass record.
entries.trigger: every CI verify run on linux and macos (Bounded dogfooding smoke test step)
entries.inputs: none; builds the checkout through install-axiom.sh and sets LINGO_PROJECTS_ROOT, LINGO_STATE_ROOT, AXIOM_CODEX_SKILLS_ROOT, AXIOM_GH_BIN to temporary paths
entries.outputs: JSON evidence record on stdout (evidence=axiom_e2e_dogfood, result=pass); any failed assertion exits non-zero
entries.network_effects: none (fake gh binary; go build may use the local module cache)
entries.authority: none; no real provider or user state is touched
entries.evidence: Prints a one-line axiom_e2e_dogfood JSON record to stdout; does not write files

entries.purpose: Build the current checkout and install it as axiom with a development ownership receipt (idempotent, refuses unowned or modified destinations).
entries.trigger: contributor installs a development build from a checkout; also run by dogfood-poc.sh on every CI verify (linux/macos)
entries.inputs: env AXIOM_BIN_DIR (default $HOME/.local/bin), AXIOM_INSTALL_STATE_ROOT (default XDG state dir/axiom/install); repository Git state
entries.outputs: JSON axiom_install result line on stdout (installed|unchanged); PATH notice on stderr; install_error and exit 1 on refusal
entries.local_effects: creates 0700 bin and state dirs; writes $AXIOM_BIN_DIR/axiom and axiom.receipt; does not edit PATH or shell profiles
entries.network_effects: none (go build may use the local module cache)
entries.authority: none; writes only under the user-chosen install and state directories

entries.purpose: Windows release-bundle entrypoint, shipped as install.ps1 in the archive, mapping native parameters to the bundled axiom.exe install-release command.
entries.trigger: packaged into every Windows release archive as install.ps1; run by users or by the bootstrap installer on install
entries.inputs: -Archive, -Checksums (required), -BinDir and -ReceiptDir (default under LOCALAPPDATA\Axiom); sibling axiom.exe
entries.outputs: Output of axiom.exe install-release; throws on non-zero exit
entries.local_effects: installs axiom.exe and receipt under the chosen BinDir/ReceiptDir via the Go installer
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: current user; explicit archive and checksums; no elevation

entries.purpose: Verify a release archive against SHA256SUMS and the host row, then fresh-install axiom with ownership receipt or delegate an owned upgrade; shipped as install.sh in the archive.
entries.trigger: packaged into every POSIX release archive as install.sh; run by install.sh on every bootstrap install and directly by users or tests
entries.inputs: --archive, --checksums, --bin-dir, --receipt-dir (all absolute); env AXIOM_INSTALL_TEST_FAIL_STAGE test seam
entries.outputs: install_status=installed|unchanged|upgraded lines on stdout; install_error/install_next on stderr; non-zero exit on refusal or partial state
entries.local_effects: creates 0700 bin/receipt dirs, lock and operation marker; writes bin-dir/axiom and installation.receipt; runs the bundled axiom upgrade for owned installs; temp dir removed
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: current user; refuses unsupported host row, checksum mismatch, symlinked, group/world-writable or foreign-owned destinations; upgrade runs with --authorize-local
entries.removal_condition: Move durable POSIX install behavior into the internal/install owner and keep the archive install.sh as a thin facade (#168 T12); requires Plan/contract review.

entries.purpose: Windows remote bootstrap: resolve a stable or exact release, download and verify the archive, then run the bundled axiom.exe install-release from private staging.
entries.trigger: users run it via Invoke-RestMethod from the raw main URL to install or upgrade Axiom on Windows
entries.inputs: -Version vX.Y.Z[-rc.N], -Channel stable, -BinDir, -ReceiptDir (defaults under LOCALAPPDATA\Axiom); env USERPROFILE, PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE
entries.outputs: Output of axiom.exe install-release; throws on unsupported host, bad selector, checksum or archive failure
entries.local_effects: private ACL-protected staging dir under USERPROFILE (removed); installs axiom.exe and receipt under BinDir/ReceiptDir via the Go installer; no PATH or global ACL changes
entries.network_effects: HTTPS only (redirects revalidated) to api.github.com latest release and github.com release assets
entries.authority: current user; no elevation; archive digest must match published SHA256SUMS

entries.purpose: POSIX remote bootstrap: resolve a stable release or exact version, download and checksum-verify the host archive, then run the bundle's release installer.
entries.trigger: users pipe it from the raw main URL (curl | sh) to install or upgrade Axiom
entries.inputs: --channel stable | --version vX.Y.Z[-rc.N], --bin-dir, --receipt-dir (default $HOME/.local/bin and XDG state); env HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, NO_COLOR
entries.outputs: install_* key=value lines on stdout; progress, summary and install_error on stderr; PATH instruction when needed; non-zero exit on failure
entries.local_effects: private temp dir removed on exit; installation effects (bin dir, receipt) are performed by the bundled installer; no sudo, PATH or profile edits
entries.network_effects: HTTPS-only curl downloads from github.com (releases/latest redirect, SHA256SUMS, release archive)
entries.authority: current user; no sudo; archive must match published SHA256SUMS and bundle manifest before execution

entries.purpose: Cross-runtime maintainer-agent evaluation: deterministic structural checks of canonical skills and Claude/Codex adapters, plus optional runtime behavioral scenarios.
entries.trigger: Every repository validation via test-maintainer-agent.sh; manual maintainer runs with --runtime claude/codex to verify cross-runtime parity.
entries.inputs: --root, --runtime (claude|codex, repeatable), --scenario, --require-runtimes, --evidence PATH; env AXIOM_MAINTAINER_EVAL_TIMEOUT (default 600s); reads AGENTS.md, .agents/skills, .claude/skills.
entries.outputs: PASS/FAIL/SKIP/UNVERIFIED lines on stdout/stderr; exit 1 on failure (or unverified with --require-runtimes); optional JSON report at --evidence.
entries.local_effects: temporary directories only; writes the JSON report only when --evidence is given
entries.network_effects: none by default; with --runtime the claude/codex CLIs run read-only and may contact their model providers
entries.authority: none for structural checks; runtime scenarios use the invoking user's existing claude/codex CLI authentication
entries.evidence: Optional JSON report written to the --evidence path; none by default.

entries.purpose: Publishes one prepared, verified artifact set as a GitHub Release (--check, --envelope or authorized publication), binding every effect to an authorized envelope digest.
entries.trigger: Every release publication (publish-release.yml) and every release.sh status/publish/verify preview of publication state
entries.inputs: --repo OWNER/NAME --tag --revision --make-latest [--dir --evidence --notes --prepared-run --authorized-digest | --check | --envelope]; env AXIOM_RELEASE_RETRY_DELAY, AXIOM_RELEASE_CORRECTIONS_*, AXIOM_RELEASE_REPAIR_REVISION, GH_TOKEN, AXIOM_RELEASE_REPOSITORY_TOKEN, AXIOM_DELIVERY_PROJECT_TOKEN
entries.outputs: stdout key=value envelope with preview_digest and effect.* lines (envelope/check) or effect= lines, publication=published and result=pass (publish); stderr release_publish_error, exit 1
entries.network_effects: GitHub API via gh: reads releases, tags, assets, PRs; publish mode creates/patches the draft release, deletes and uploads draft assets, publishes, relabels the Release PR and runs delivery-github.sh Issue/Project effects
entries.authority: gh credentials of the caller; publication needs --authorized-digest equal to the envelope recomputed here; in the workflow GH_TOKEN is AXIOM_RELEASE_PUBLISH_TOKEN inside the protected release environment
entries.evidence: Consumes release-evidence.txt (verify-release-artifacts.sh) and release-notes.md of the prepared run; emits the publication envelope and effect= records

entries.purpose: Resolves and validates an explicitly pinned, append-only delivery-corrections input against the original release range using Git reads only.

entries.outputs: stdout corrections_revision= and corrections_sha256=; stderr release_corrections_error and exit 1; optionally copies the pinned corrections file to --file-output
entries.local_effects: Writes --file-output when given; otherwise temporary directories only
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: none; read-only Git checks of pinned revisions
entries.evidence: Emits release-recovery.txt content (pinned revision and digest) that the prepared run retains and verify-prepared-release.sh compares

entries.purpose: Prints the deterministic GitHub Release body for one tag and revision: Release Please changelog section, delivered Issues, provenance and install command.
entries.trigger: Every release preparation run (release-artifacts.yml) and every prepared-set verification (verify-prepared-release.sh), plus recovery publication checks
entries.inputs: --tag --revision --repo OWNER/NAME; env AXIOM_RELEASE_CORRECTIONS_REVISION/DIGEST for recovery; reads CHANGELOG.md at the revision
entries.outputs: stdout release notes Markdown; stderr release_notes_error and exit 1
entries.network_effects: GitHub API via delivery-github.sh titles (read-only Issue titles) for stable releases
entries.authority: none beyond a read token (issues: read in the workflow)
entries.evidence: Produces release-notes.md retained in the prepared run and recompared at publication

entries.purpose: Preflights a new stable release before any Release PR: validates the commit range, delivery metadata and SemVer plan and prints the planned version.
entries.trigger: Every release start (release.sh start) and the Release PR workflow re-run on the planned main SHA
entries.inputs: [--main-ref REF default origin/main] [--remote NAME default origin]; reads Git history, .release-please-manifest.json, delivery metadata via delivery-issues.sh
entries.outputs: stdout closed key=value Evidence ending result=pass (releasable, planned_version, issues, change.N); stderr release_plan_error and exit 1
entries.network_effects: git ls-remote --tags against the remote (read-only)
entries.authority: none; read-only Git checks
entries.evidence: Plan Evidence written to the Release PR workflow step summary

entries.purpose: Resolves the bot Release PR and, for the planned version and validated main, dispatches the required CI and delivery-metadata workflows on its branch.
entries.trigger: Every Release PR workflow run (release-please.yml) after Release Please runs
entries.inputs: mode resolve|dispatch, REPO (must be rgomids/axiom), [VERSION], MAIN SHA (dispatch); needs gh in PATH with GH_TOKEN
entries.outputs: stdout release_pr=, release_pr_base=, release_pr_checks=no_open_release_pr|dispatched; stderr release_pr_checks_error and exit 1
entries.network_effects: GitHub API via gh reads (pulls, refs, compare); dispatch mode runs gh workflow run for ci.yml and delivery-metadata.yml on the Release PR branch
entries.authority: GITHUB_TOKEN with actions: write in release-please.yml; dispatch only for the exact planned head

entries.purpose: Decides from Git facts whether one tag may be published from one exact revision, covering stable and release-candidate rules, and prints closed Evidence.
entries.trigger: Every release preparation, status, publish and prepared-set verification (release-artifacts.yml, release.sh, verify-prepared-release.sh)
entries.inputs: --tag --revision [--main-ref default origin/main] [--remote default origin]; reads Git history, manifest and remote tags

entries.network_effects: git ls-remote --tags against the remote (read-only)
entries.authority: none; read-only, never creates tags, releases or refs
entries.evidence: Produces preflight.txt retained in the prepared release artifact

entries.purpose: Sourced library of the explicit recovery protocol: validates pinned correction inputs and renders and checks recovery provenance lines in release notes.
entries.trigger: Sourced whenever a release run carries explicit correction pins (release.sh, notes, publication, repair and delivery scripts)
entries.inputs: Sourced, not executed; caller must define repository_root and fail(); env AXIOM_RELEASE_CORRECTIONS_REVISION and AXIOM_RELEASE_CORRECTIONS_DIGEST
entries.outputs: Defines recovery_validate, recovery_note_lines and recovery_check_notes; no standalone output; failures go through the caller's fail()
entries.network_effects: none
entries.authority: none; pins are explicit inputs, never a floating-ref fallback
entries.evidence: Produces recovery pin provenance lines compared with published and prepared release notes

entries.purpose: Validates a separately pinned control-code repair revision for an already published immutable recovery release, keeping original correction provenance fixed.

entries.inputs: --repo --tag --revision --repair-revision; env AXIOM_RELEASE_CORRECTIONS_REVISION and DIGEST required; reads .github/rulesets/main.json

entries.network_effects: GitHub API via gh reads (check runs of the repair revision, published release by tag)
entries.authority: read token with checks: read; the caller must gate required CI with trusted code before executing this file
entries.evidence: Consumes published release notes recovery provenance; emits repair_revision

entries.authority: none; pure parser
